title: Plugin manifest
description: Shape of .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Checks structure only -- it doesn't verify that paths named in `skills`/`commands`/`hooks` actually exist, or that `version` matches package.json (see scripts/sync-plugin-version.mjs for that).

experimental.description: Claude Code experimental settings. `evals` names the directory `claude plugin eval` reads its suite from (this repo uses plugin-evals/, since evals/ holds the trigger-routing cases).

hooks.description: Path to a hooks manifest (e.g. hooks/hooks.json). This repo ships no hooks, so its own plugin.json doesn't set this key, but it's included here as a documented, conceptually valid key other plugin.json consumers may use.
